metadata.project: ManuMind AI — Explainable Multi-Agent AI System for Manufacturing Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis
metadata.document_type: Controlled Noise Experiment Plan & Frozen-Model Evaluation Protocol
metadata.execution_prohibition: DO NOT execute without explicit user approval. All models, weights, scalers, thresholds, and data remain frozen.

overlapping_window_configuration.formula: floor((N_test - W) / S) + 1 = floor((600 - 30) / 10) + 1 = 57 + 1 = 58 windows per machine
overlapping_window_configuration.corroboration: Matches exact shape (580, 30, 5) in data/processed/sequences_test.npz and clean_sensor_windows.csv (test partition = 580)

non_overlapping_window_configuration.formula: floor(N_test / W) = floor(600 / 30) = 20 windows per machine

preservation_constraints.raw_csv_files: IMMUTABLE (data/raw/sensor_readings.csv, maintenance_history.csv must not be overwritten)
preservation_constraints.processed_csv_files: IMMUTABLE (data/processed/sensor_train.csv, sensor_val.csv, sensor_test.csv must not be overwritten)
preservation_constraints.preprocessed_sequences: IMMUTABLE (data/processed/sequences_train.npz, sequences_val.npz, sequences_test.npz must not be overwritten)
preservation_constraints.model_weights: IMMUTABLE (isolation_forest.joblib and lstm_autoencoder.keras must not be retrained)
preservation_constraints.thresholds: IMMUTABLE (calibrated thresholds 0.0269 and 0.901464 must not be recalibrated)
preservation_constraints.database_state: IMMUTABLE (SQLite manumind.db and Supabase cloud 40,416 rows must remain untouched)

experiment_a_frozen_model_robustness.purpose: Evaluate current production models on synthetic noisy sensor copies without modifying models or thresholds.
experiment_a_frozen_model_robustness.operational_mode: In-memory evaluation only on synthetic validation/test evaluation copies.
experiment_a_frozen_model_robustness.models: FROZEN (IF and LSTM Autoencoder trained in Steps 2 & 3).

experiment_b_noise_augmented_training.purpose: Investigate whether retraining models on noise-injected data improves robustness and generalization.
experiment_b_noise_augmented_training.operational_mode: SEPARATELY APPROVED FUTURE TASK. Strictly prohibited during Phase 2 Step 4/Step 4 review.

experiments.name: Original Dataset Baseline
experiments.description: Baseline performance benchmark using unaltered test telemetry under frozen model thresholds.
experiments.data_scope: Full test partition (6,000 readings; 200 non-overlapping windows; 580 overlapping sequences).
experiments.limitations: Does not test model robustness against unexpected industrial sensor jitter or degradation.

experiments.name: Low Independent Gaussian Noise
experiments.description: Adds independent Gaussian white noise scaled to 5% of healthy training standard deviation (alpha = 0.05).
experiments.perturbation_level_label: Experimental synthetic perturbation level: 5% of healthy training sigma (Not an industrial tolerance standard)
experiments.data_scope: In-memory test evaluation copy (both healthy and faulty readings perturbed).

expected_outcomes.isolation_forest_impact: Negligible impact (<0.5% F1 degradation); score boundary marginally perturbed.
expected_outcomes.lstm_autoencoder_impact: Mean reconstruction error increases by ~0.002–0.005 MSE; negligible false positive increase.
expected_outcomes.attribution_stability: >98% rank-order consistency of top attributable sensor.

experiments.limitations: Assumes zero temporal autocorrelation; high-frequency white noise is easily smoothed by LSTM filters.

experiments.name: Moderate Independent Gaussian Noise
experiments.description: Adds independent Gaussian white noise scaled to 10% of healthy training standard deviation (alpha = 0.10).
experiments.perturbation_level_label: Experimental synthetic perturbation level: 10% of healthy training sigma (Not an industrial tolerance standard)
experiments.data_scope: In-memory test evaluation copy (both healthy and faulty readings perturbed).

expected_outcomes.isolation_forest_impact: False positive rate increases from 6.69% to ~8.5–10.0%; F1 drops ~2–3%.
expected_outcomes.lstm_autoencoder_impact: Reconstruction error baseline shifts up by ~0.010–0.025 MSE; F1 remains >96%.
expected_outcomes.early_warning_impact: Incipient fault recall decreases by 5–10% as signal-to-noise ratio degrades at onset.

experiments.limitations: Does not account for correlated physical inertia or thermal thermal masses.

experiments.name: High Independent Gaussian Noise
experiments.description: Adds heavy Gaussian white noise scaled to 20% of healthy training standard deviation (alpha = 0.20).
experiments.perturbation_level_label: Experimental synthetic perturbation level: 20% of healthy training sigma (Severe stress test; not a vendor tolerance standard)
experiments.data_scope: In-memory test evaluation copy (both healthy and faulty readings perturbed).

expected_outcomes.isolation_forest_impact: Severe FPR escalation (>15%); precision drops significantly as healthy tails breach partition walls.
expected_outcomes.lstm_autoencoder_impact: Test FPR increases from 0.86% to ~4–6%; incipient detection delay increases by 20–40 timesteps.
expected_outcomes.attribution_stability: Feature attribution entropy increases; non-faulted sensors gain 5–10% residual attribution.

experiments.limitations: Severe white noise at 20% sigma represents harsh electromagnetic interference rather than normal telemetry.

experiments.name: Temporally Correlated Noise via AR(1) Process
experiments.description: Simulates sensor inertia and sluggishness via a first-order autoregressive AR(1) colored noise process with stationary standard deviation sigma_stat = 0.10 * sigma_c and rho = 0.65.
experiments.perturbation_level_label: Experimental synthetic perturbation level: 10% stationary sigma with rho = 0.65

distinction_definition.stationary_noise_std: sigma_stat: Long-run marginal dispersion of the noise process across time (0.10 * sigma_c).
distinction_definition.innovation_noise_std: sigma_eta: Dispersion of the independent random shock injected at each discrete timestep (0.07599 * sigma_c).

initialization_procedure.burn_in_rule: Generate 100 preliminary recursive steps starting from 0 and discard them prior to coupling with telemetry to guarantee strict stationarity from t=1.

expected_outcomes.isolation_forest_impact: Tabular point detector experiences bursty false alarms during sustained excursions.
expected_outcomes.lstm_autoencoder_impact: Evaluates sequence reconstruction response to smooth low-frequency colored noise.
expected_outcomes.attribution_stability: Maintains physical root cause ranking while tracking correlated drift.

experiments.limitations: Fixed rho = 0.65 across all sensors ignores differing physical time constants (e.g. thermal vs mechanical).

experiments.name: Gradual Sensor Calibration Drift
experiments.description: Simulates sensor aging, fouling, or zero-point calibration drift as a linear offset over the final 600 steps.
experiments.perturbation_level_label: Experimental synthetic perturbation assumption (Requires empirical validation for specific transducer models)
experiments.data_scope: In-memory test evaluation copy (applied during final 600 test steps).

expected_outcomes.isolation_forest_impact: Healthy machine false positive rate escalates significantly towards test sequence end.
expected_outcomes.lstm_autoencoder_impact: Reconstruction error gradually surpasses threshold tau_LSTM, inducing false alarms on healthy machines.
expected_outcomes.attribution_stability: Drifting sensor erroneously absorbs attribution percentage on healthy assets.

experiments.limitations: Linear drift is an idealized approximation; actual industrial sensor fouling often shows non-linear saturation.

experiments.name: Occasional Transient Spikes
experiments.description: Simulates sparse electromagnetic interference, switching transients, or telemetry glitches as 2-step pulses.
experiments.mathematical_formula: x'_{t,c} = x_{t,c} + S_{t,c} \cdot A_{t,c}, \quad S_{t,c} \sim \text{Bernoulli}(p = 0.002), \quad A_{t,c} \sim \mathcal{U}(3.0 \cdot \sigma_c, 5.0 \cdot \sigma_c) \cdot \text{Rademacher}(\pm 1)
experiments.perturbation_level_label: Experimental synthetic perturbation assumption (Requires validation against specific edge gateway telemetry logs)

expected_outcomes.isolation_forest_impact: Produces isolated 1-to-2 step tabular false alarms.
expected_outcomes.lstm_autoencoder_impact: Produces elevated reconstruction errors spanning 30 consecutive windows as pulse traverses sequence buffer.
expected_outcomes.attribution_stability: Transiently spikes attribution for perturbed feature, recovering immediately after pulse exits.

experiments.limitations: Real hardware often applies median filtering in firmware that rejects isolated single-sample spikes.

experiments.name: Combined Realistic Disturbance Scenario
experiments.description: Composite realistic manufacturing factory environment combining 10% stationary AR(1) colored noise (rho=0.50), subtle calibration drift (0.5 * sigma_c over test partition), and rare transient electrical spikes (p=0.001).
experiments.perturbation_level_label: Experimental synthetic composite scenario (Multi-stress exploratory testing)
experiments.data_scope: Full test evaluation copy under frozen models (580 overlapping sequences; 200 non-overlapping windows).

expected_outcomes.isolation_forest_impact: F1 expected to drop from 95.22% to ~88–91%; FPR ~10–12%.
expected_outcomes.lstm_autoencoder_impact: F1 expected to drop from 99.15% to ~93–95%; FPR ~2.5–4.0%.
expected_outcomes.early_warning_impact: Incipient detection delay increases by ~15–25 timesteps (1.25–2.0 hours).
expected_outcomes.attribution_stability: Maintains physical root cause ranking on severe faults, but incipient stage attribution shows increased noise floor.

experiments.limitations: Multi-parameter interactions between drift and AR(1) autocorrelation may produce compound effects.

frozen_model_evaluation_protocol.scaler_transform_rule: StandardScaler (ml/models_store/sensor_scaler.joblib) MUST NOT be refitted. Apply scaler.transform(X_noisy) directly using original mean_ and scale_ parameters.

window_level_differentiation.overlapping_windows: Stride=10 evaluation (exactly 580 test sequences; 58 per machine) matching Step 3 LSTM evaluation protocol.
window_level_differentiation.non_overlapping_windows: Stride=30 evaluation (exactly 200 test windows; 20 per machine) for independent window benchmarking.
window_level_differentiation.point_level_metrics: 6,000 tabular time steps (600 per machine) for Isolation Forest baseline.

explainability_metrics: Top-1 Attribution Feature Agreement (% match with ground-truth fault driver)
Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of attribution distribution vs. E0 baseline
Attribution Entropy (measuring dispersion and noise-induced dilution)
Signed Residual Concordance (directionality preservation in standardized space)

target_metrics: First Anomaly Detection Time (Step index of first alarm)
Detection Delay (Timesteps elapsed after fault onset t=2600)
False Alarm Rate on Healthy Machines (M101, M103, M105, M106, M108, M110)
